# Turborepo Monorepo Starter
> Developer platform and monorepo shell for shipping high-performance applications on Bun and Turborepo.

## Architectural Model
- Monorepo Shell: Root repository manages governance, quality gates, CI/CD, and developer tooling.
- Dynamic Workspaces: Applications live under `apps/<app>/` (e.g. `apps/web`, `apps/cms`).
- Scoped CLI: `bun root <task>`, `bun ws <app> <task>`, `bun adopt <path>`.
- Quality Gates: `bun run gate:quick` (pre-commit), `bun run gate:push` (pre-push), `bun run gate:ci` (CI).

## Workspaces Directory
- `apps/` — Application workspaces (adopt starters via `bun adopt apps/<app>`)
- `scripts/` — CLI, quality gates, CI runners, and audits
- `docs/` — Architecture documentation, ADR records (`docs/adr/`), and guides
- `specs/` — Feature specifications
- `.agents/skills/` — AI procedural skills and coding standards
